name: University of Pecs
description: Founded in 1367, the University of Pécs is one of Europe’s oldest and most prestigious institutions, hosting over 29,000 students across 10 faculties and 500+ programs. Ranked in the top 700 globally by QS World University Rankings, the university combines cutting-edge research with a vibrant student life in the UNESCO-listed city of Pécs, a cultural hub with Ottoman heritage and modern European charm.
